item.description: President of the Trinidad and Tobago Cycling Federation, Rowena Williams joins Virmala on set to discuss the upcoming Easter International Cycling Grand Prix.

item.title: Redefining Normal – Cerebral Palsy Awareness Month - TTT News
item.description: Shamla examines the details of Cerebral Palsy with Neurologist Dr. Nicholas Maraj. Take a look as they explore the realities, challenges, and triumphs of life of persons living with CP.

item.title: Yellow Fever Case Confirmed In Monkey - TTT News
item.description: The Ministry of Health advises that, through laboratory testing, Yellow Fever has been confirmed in a deceased Red Howler monkey. item.description: Minister of Foreign and CARICOM Affairs Sean Sobers says there are many opportunities for this country to benefit from India. item.title: Destra Garcia Delivers Powerful ‘Reflections’ Performance - TTT News
item.description: Soca artiste Destra Garcia returned to the Queen’s Hall stage on Saturday night for the second instalment of her concert series, Reflections: Sound, Spirit, Surrender. item.title: Aranguez/St Joseph And Barataria/San Juan MPs Host Landmark Joint Eid Celebration - TTT News
item.description: Two Members of Parliament set aside constituency lines on Sunday, coming together to host a landmark joint Eid-ul-Fitr celebration at the Aranguez Sports Club Ground. MP for Aranguez/St Joseph, Devesh Maharaj, and MP for Barataria/San Juan, Saddam Hosein, welcomed hundreds of residents to what Minister Maharaj described as a natural coming together of neighbouring communities.

item.title: Drums, Voices, And Unity: Couva Celebrates Liberation Day - TTT News
item.description: Drums thundered, voices rose, and a powerful spirit of unity filled the air in Balmain, Couva, as hundreds of faithful gathered to celebrate Spiritual Baptists Liberation Day, honouring a legacy that was once suppressed and is now proudly expressed through faith, freedom, and cultural identity.

item.title: PM Reaffirms Commitment To Spiritual Baptist Secondary School - TTT News
item.description: Prime Minister Kamla Persad-Bissessar SC has reiterated the government’s commitment to working with the Spiritual Baptist community to establish a long-awaited Secondary School for the faith. item.title: Minister Benjamin Leads 75th Spiritual Baptist Liberation Thanksgiving In Moruga - TTT News
item.description: Hundreds of Spiritual Baptists took to the streets of Moruga on Monday, filling the air with chants, drums, and celebration as they marked 75 years of liberation from oppression. item.title: Business Insight – Cedros Bay Introduces Caribbean-Made Liquid Handwash - TTT News
item.description: A locally grown beauty brand is expanding its footprint in supermarkets across Trinidad and Tobago. The Coconut Growers Association (CGA) has launched a new all-natural liquid handwash line under its Cedros Bay brand, targeting growing consumer demand for clean, Caribbean-made personal-care products. Sunil Lalla has the latest in this week’s Business Insight.

item.title: FIFA Series Ends On Bittersweet Note For T&T - TTT News
item.description: Trinidad and Tobago's FIFA Series campaign ended on a bittersweet note, twice coming from behind to secure a 2-2 draw against Gabon in Tashkent, before losing 3-2 on penalties. Naasira Mohammed has the details.

item.title: TTPFL: Point Fortin Civic FC Secure Survival - TTT News
item.description: Point Fortin Civic FC were on the verge of relegation from Tier 1 in the TT Premier Football League but did what they had to do in their final game against Central FC Reboot and avoided relegation.

item.description: Australia Women have taken an unassailable 2-0 lead in their ODI series against the West Indies after a dominant 90-run victory in St Kitts.
